description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Scrivener.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, it and Lonis trigger.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
